scenes.teacher_script: Today, we'll learn about what a balanced diet is and why it's so important for our health.

template_data.title: What is a Balanced Diet?
template_data.subtitle: Fueling Your Body for Health and Growth

scenes.purpose: Define a balanced diet and its key components
scenes.teacher_script: A balanced diet provides all the essential nutrients our body needs in the right amounts. It includes carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, and water.

scenes.purpose: Explain the immediate benefits of a balanced diet
scenes.teacher_script: Following a balanced diet gives us energy for daily activities and helps our body grow and repair itself.

scenes.purpose: Explain the long-term benefits of a balanced diet
scenes.teacher_script: It also strengthens our immune system, helping us fight off illnesses. Moreover, it protects us from many diseases like obesity and heart problems.

scenes.purpose: Compare a balanced diet with an unbalanced diet
scenes.teacher_script: An unbalanced diet, lacking essential nutrients, can lead to fatigue and health issues. A balanced diet, however, keeps us healthy and active.

bullets: Leads to good health and energy

scenes.teacher_script: Can you recall why a balanced diet is important? Think about the key benefits we discussed.
